description: Postgres MCP Pro provides configurable read/write access and performance analysis for you and your AI agents.
commit_message:
fix: Pin mcp[cli]<2.0 to prevent breaking import change #187 (#201)

mcp 2.0.0 was released and removed mcp.server.fastmcp, which
postgres-mcp imports. The unconstrained mcp[cli]>=1.25.0 dependency
allows pip/uvx to pull in 2.0.0, causing:

  ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mcp.server.fastmcp'

Pin to mcp[cli]>=1.25.0,<2.0 until the codebase is updated for
the mcp 2.x API.

Closes #187

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>
